title: Outcome-Routed Distillation and Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.19271v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation provides dense supervision on the student's own samples, but its targets still come from the teacher. Verifier reinforcement learning (RL) instead uses an outcome signal, but it provides no direct constraint on capabilities outside the verifier. Combining the two is difficult for diffusion language models (dLLMs), because bidirectional denoising makes the policy likelihoods required by ratio-based RL unreliable.   We develop a likelihood-free pipeline for a mixture-of-experts dLLM. Each rollout group is routed by verifier outcome. Mixed groups use ratio-free, group-centred REINFORCE. If every student rollout fails but a teacher succeeds, the model receives dense KL supervision on the student's denoising canvases. All other groups are skipped. translated_title: 面向扩散语言模型的结果路由蒸馏与强化学习
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏能够对学生模型自身生成的样本提供密集监督，但其监督目标仍然来自教师模型。基于验证器的强化学习（RL）则使用结果信号，但对验证器覆盖范围之外的能力没有直接约束。将两者结合起来对于扩散语言模型而言十分困难，因为双向去噪机制使得基于比率的方法所需的策略似然变得不可靠。我们为混合专家架构的扩散语言模型开发了一个无需似然的训练流水线。每个 rollout 组根据验证器结果进行路由：混合组使用无比率、组中心化的 REINFORCE 方法；如果学生模型的所有 rollout 都失败但教师模型成功，则模型在学生的去噪画布上接受来自教师的密集 KL 监督；其余所有组则被跳过。一个锚定于蒸馏后检查点的 KL 项限制了模型在验证器奖励之外的变动。该工具调用教师模型仅在 18.6% 的训练提示上成功。在 24 个去噪
tldr: 提出一种无需似然的结果路由蒸馏与强化学习流水线，通过验证器结果路由 rollout 组，结合无比率 REINFORCE、教师密集 KL 监督与检查点锚定 KL 约束，有效训练扩散语言模型。
en_tdlr: A likelihood-free, outcome-routed pipeline that combines on-policy distillation with verifier RL for diffusion language models, routing rollout groups by verifier outcome and using ratio-free REINFORCE, dense teacher KL supervision, and checkpoint-anchored KL regularization.
